name: pyrox
description: Claude Code plugins for probabilistic modelling with Equinox and NumPyro on pyrox, and for extreme value analysis on pyrox-xtreme.

plugins.name: pyrox
plugins.description: Build Bayesian models on pyrox (the Equinox ↔ NumPyro bridge, pyrox-gp, pyrox-nn, pyrox-lgm) instead of re-implementing site plumbing, GP likelihoods, Bayesian layers or INLA: a model-building skill and a reuse reviewer.

plugins.name: pyrox-xtreme
plugins.description: Build extreme value analyses on pyrox-xtreme (NumPyro GEV / GPD / Gumbel / Fréchet / Weibull distributions, stable pure-JAX primitives, return levels, point processes, xarray block maxima, thresholds and declustering) instead of re-implementing them: an extreme-value-analysis skill and a reuse reviewer.
